newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Grand Met ratings.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps reaffirms Grand Met ratings.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it reaffirmed its ratings of Grand Metropolitan PLC's Eurobonds, debentures and notes at Single A, preferred stock at Single A Minus and commercial paper rating at D One.
This action covers 4.4 billion stg of Grand Met's debt and preferred stock.

As the company focuses on increasing its return on invested capital and shareholder value, it has indicated that large acquisitions, which take years to earn their cost of capital, are no longer a part of its growth strategy. As a result, sizable debt-financed acquisitions are not expected, and debt levels are likely to remain stable in the near to intermediate term, Duff & Phelps said.
